component.name: OpenPowerMac
component.summary: Power Macintosh G4 emulator written from scratch

description.p: OpenPowerMac emulates the Power Mac G4 (AGP Graphics): a PowerPC G4 processor with AltiVec, the board's storage, USB and sound, and a Rage 128 Pro graphics card with 2D and 3D acceleration, written from scratch from public documentation. It starts Mac OS 9 from an installation CD, installs it on a disk it creates, and runs it from there, 3D games included.

OpenPowerMac contains no original Macintosh code. You supply the Boot ROM of the machine you own, the graphics card's ROM and your own system disks. Files and folders dropped on the window appear in the Mac with no restart.
